messages:
carmen: Heads up — planned late swap for runtime kernel+quant bundle tonight during quiet window 23:00-01:00 UTC. Deploy bot shows a staged push to night-batch group A (5% traffic) then progressive slices. Need quick thumbs on fallback image and rollback TTL. :eyes:

alice: thanks — do we have a fallback image that preserves v2 matmul path? last time the fallback caused perf regressions.

ben: pinging perf: what metrics should we watch in the first 10m? I want explicit thresholds for p99 latency and OOM rate.

carmen: fallback image is runtime:v2026.03-fallback (pins matmul-v1). We'll use that if canary error rate > 1% or p99 > baseline+40ms. Canary slices: 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100%. Rollback TTL = immediate (zero wait) if OOM seen, otherwise 10m observation per slice.

dmitri (deploy-bot): Scheduled deployjob #DJ-8821 created by carmen. Stages: night-batch-A (5%), night-batch-B (20%), regional-split (50%), global (100%). Current state: queued. Automation note: auto-rollback enabled for OOM or >1% 5m error spike.

sre-oncall: add monitors: kernel.evictions >= 1/month? jk. For tonight: alert on node OOMs (any), rpc 5xx > 0.5% sustained 3m, p99 headroom < 30ms. If any of these fire during a slice, roll back immediately.

alice: can you also attach the smoke checklist? small smoke tests: 
- infer_small.json (seq64) smoke x50
- kv-cache-warm check (prefix reuse)

carmen: paste of the smoke commands we'll run:
```
# smoke runner
./smoke-runner --target night-batch-A --tests infer_small.json --retries 2
# quick perf probe
./p99-probe --model gpt-small --qps 10 --duration 120
```

ben: telemetry links: https://telemetry.redwood/proj/runtime/nightly-DJ-8821 (use the Live tab). I'll be watching p99/p50/p95 and OOM count.

dmitri (deploy-bot): NOTE: deploy window will lock 15m before stage start. To cancel: `/deploy cancel DJ-8821` or react :no_entry_sign:. To pin a release note: `/release pin DJ-8821 "kernel+quant: night swap - holdback"`

carmen: quick check: release notes drafted, but need approvals from eng-qa and sec before global. tagging here: @alice @ben please review. If no objections in 30m we'll proceed with canary. :shipit:
